placebo_irrelevant.label: Content-irrelevant placebo

placebo_ablated.label: Placebo without placeholder and invent-facts clauses
placebo_ablated.suffix: Write carefully. Do not leave out the main point, contradict yourself, introduce undefined jargon, or address the wrong audience.

placebo_placeholder_only.label: Placeholder clause only
